name: RC-B10-0190/2024 – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the shrinking space for civil society in Cambodia, in particular the case of the labour rights organisation CENTRAL
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and asking for action. It condemns the shrinking space for civil society in Cambodia and the pressure on groups like CENTRAL, a labour rights organisation. It asks Cambodia to drop charges against CENTRAL and release political prisoners. It also asks the European Union to review trade benefits for Cambodia, consider sanctions, and give more support to Cambodian civil society.

- No law changes; Parliament asks Cambodia to drop charges and release prisoners.
- Affects Cambodia's government, unions and civil society, and EU companies sourcing there.
- Next, the EU reviews trade benefits and considers sanctions and more support.
